name: flow-dual-review
description: Run parallel zero-context correctness and quality reviews over a Git range or Flow chapter with quota-aware model allocation.

git_range.description: Exact Git revision range to review (for example main..HEAD).

spec_path.description: Relative path to the active spec.md or chapter spec.md.

review_mode.description: Run parallel dual review or single combined review for Small changes (default dual).

reviewer_model.description: Preferred reviewer model option (default inherit when session is Pro/Pro-Next, or pass pro when session is Flash; falls back to flash on quota).

code_reviewer_agent.description: Optional pinned agent profile for correctness and spec review (default self).

quality_reviewer_agent.description: Optional pinned agent profile for quality and debloat review (defaults to code_reviewer_agent or self).

fallback_model.description: Optional fallback model tier when primary review quota is exhausted (default flash).
